scope: Historical Shan-Chen MCMP velocity-convention comparison: static droplet, stratified Poiseuille, and momentum ledger. Separate from the maintained stratified benchmark. Figures were rendered from existing data; no new simulation verdict.

criteria.primary: relative deviation between GOT-MIX and the OSS arm, per observable: sigma (surface tension from dp*R), u_max_spurious, Poiseuille u_max / volume flux Q / profile L2. |dev| <= 15% = acceptable (owner precision standard).
ground_truth_checks: Young-Laplace: sigma = dp*R must be radius independent; residual = max_i |dp_i R_i - mean| / mean (percent).
Stratified Poiseuille: relative error of u_max and Q against analytic.py, in-house strict bound 3%.
Global momentum: |P(t)-P(0)| / |P(0)| and absolute per-step drift.
criteria.unit_of_analysis: one (arm, workload, configuration) triple; no averaging across arms.

thresholds.control_must_fail: CTRL-NORM deviation >= 15% on at least one primary observable, otherwise the harness is falsified (see falsification)
